title: Fairkit, Fairkit, on the Wall, Who’s the Fairest of Them All? Supporting Data Scientists in Training Fair Models
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to algorithmic fairness, which is a central pillar of AI ethics. It focuses on the definitions, metrics, and tools used to evaluate and ensure moral fairness in automated decision-making systems, making it an ethics-centered study rather than just a paper with a brief ethical considerations section.
